data.body: **[P2] Preserve invocation-end cleanup when draining throws.** If the root thread is interrupted while an asynchronous operation remains unfinished, `waitForRunningUserHandlers()` converts the interrupted `get()` into an `IllegalStateException`. This new call propagates that exception before `finishInvocation()`, so an invocation that fired `onInvocationStart` never fires `onInvocationEnd`. OpenTelemetry consequently leaves its handler scope and invocation span open. Route drain failures through lifecycle finalization while retaining the original exception, and add an interrupted-root/unfinished-step regression test.
